CREATING MORE AND BETTER JOBS
Greater St. Louis, Inc. forges partnerships that empower growth across the 15-county St. Louis region. We are conveners and collaborators. Together with our partners, we work to build a thriving and inclusive St. Louis that will attract and retain investment and talent for generations to come.
Learn More

World Wide Technology, Inc.
Jonathan Silva, Founder, SentiAR
St. Louis has been a great place to start a company. We’ve found very supportive investors. And especially when we were starting, we found a very good community to help us think through how to put together a company.
Jonathan Silva
Founder, SentiAR
Shu Schiller
If I am a company looking for a place to invest, I have to look at what resources are provided, where there are talented people who will be hired, and how the region is growing. That’s all here.
Shu Schiller
Ph.D., Dean, College of Business Administration, University of Missouri-St. Louis
Kay Wells, Founder, Posie Pots
The community is amazing. I’ve lived in multiple other cities and have traveled to almost all 50 states, and St. Louis just has really good community hometown support.
Kay Wells
Founder, Posie Pots
Katie Murphy, Plant Biologist, Donald Danforth Plant Science Center
Yes, there are other wonderful places to study and work, but if you want to make sure you can put roots down in a city — pun intended — and you want to be a plant scientist, move to St. Louis.
Katie Murphy
Plant Biologist, Donald Danforth Plant Science Center
Kristen Sorth, CEO and Director, St. Louis County Library
There are so many people who are interested in moving St. Louis forward. We try to show up at all the tables. Whether we’re talking about how to improve the region or how to support the community, St. Louis County Library is here.
Kristen Sorth
CEO and Director, St. Louis County Library
